mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 50% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based demand weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not lead to negative 20d returns in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When manufacturing output (INDPRO) falls below 100, indicating a contraction in the manufacturing sector, it signals economic weakness and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand for housing, a leading indicator of economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 50% of instances when HOUST > 1300.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 0.3% signals accelerating inflation, prompting a hawkish monetary policy response and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates severe labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE does not lead to negative 60d returns in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a slow GDP growth regime (GDPC1 quarterly growth < 1.0% annualized), reduced corporate earnings growth leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 50% of instances when GDPC1 quarterly growth < 1.0% annualized.
